steps.label: the coast road is walkable all the way east

the coast road runs ABOVE the shingle now, and the shingle is still its own encounter region - you step down onto the beach to meet the crabs. On the 50x50 the road was on the sand, because the beach was a two-row scan of every southern column and the road was in it; the 120x120's shore falls away south-east and the road stays inland of it
the south is on the record
